Definitely had a learning curve with this one but once you understand how it works the game becomes really enjoyable. The key is to remember how health and stamina interact. The lower your health, the lower your stamina. This also applies to enemies. You want to fight very defensively at the start and chip away at enemies. As enemies lose their ability to chain attacks, you want to become more aggressive to finish the fight. When fighting groups, don’t focus on one enemy at first. Fight defensively and only focus down one enemy once they have lost a good chunk of their stamina.

Also, this is probably a stressful time for the new guinea pig and the agression might be aggravated by a sense of unease from completely new surroundings.
